chaining: An ARM v8 machine with 4 GB for EUR 3.99 a month is the cheapest always-on CPU after the free tiers, and the architecture is the whole caveat: x86 binaries and most prebuilt CUDA tooling will not run on it, so it is a scheduler, a proxy, a queue consumer or an ARM-native build host rather than a general worker
